token_unit: lexical tokens matched by [a-z0-9]+(?:[._+-][a-z0-9]+)* over NFKC-lowercased page content; punctuation, symbols, and whitespace are excluded, so this count is smaller than the model tokenizer count for the same Markdown and must not be sized directly against controls.model.context_size
score_rule: sum((1 + ln(tf_page)) * (1 + ln((N + 1) / (df + 1)))) over unique query terms; ties by page_id
